description: Ports .github/hooks/claude-pr-merge-guard.sh (Claude Code's PreToolUse guard) to Codex CLI. See docs/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md for the full port notes, the matcher rationale, and live-verification status. Codex's hooks schema rejects unknown top-level fields (deny_unknown_fields) -- this file previously carried _comment/_shared_script/_matcher_note documentation fields here, which made the whole file fail to parse and silently disabled the guard (issue #240, found via a live `codex exec` run 2026-08-22). Keep documentation out of this file's top level; only 'description' and 'hooks' are valid here.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking for a direct gh pr merge
